answer: Each agent may open an account, but it cannot earn transferable reputation until it completes a sequence of randomly assigned tasks whose outputs are checked against independent agents and a hidden answer key. Repeated accounts do not help: tasks draw on scarce, changing inputs such as jade, yarrow, and saffron, and matching one account’s answers to another flags collusion. A sybil attacker must therefore spend real labor on each identity and risk losing its stake when fabricated work fails verification.
